label: Трубка
description: A 10-sentence usage card for трубка (pipe; receiver).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Трубка' stays in the nominative case as the subject of 'лежит'. 'Его' marks the owner, and 'на столе' gives the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Трубку' is the accusative direct object of 'курит'. 'Старую' agrees in the feminine accusative, describing the old pipe.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Трубки' is in the genitive case after 'нет', the standard negation of existence. 'Телефонной' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К трубке' uses the dative form 'трубке' after 'к' to express approaching. 'Телефонной' agrees in the feminine dative.

missions.phrase: Он говорил с трубкой в руке.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental of accompaniment. 'С трубкой' uses the instrumental form 'трубкой' after 'с' to describe holding it. 'В руке' gives the prepositional place.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В трубке' uses the prepositional form 'трубке' after 'в' to locate the noise in the receiver. 'Шум' is the accusative object of 'слышу'.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Трубка' is nominative as the subject. 'Дорогая' is the agreeing feminine predicate adjective, and 'очень' intensifies it.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Трубки' is the nominative plural of 'трубка', acting as the subject of 'стоят'. 'Красивые' agrees in the plural, and 'на полке' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Трубку' is the accusative direct object of 'положил', here meaning he hung up the phone. The verb 'ушёл' continues the action.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Без трубки' uses the genitive form 'трубки' after 'без' to express absence. The impersonal 'ему было скучно' adds the dative experiencer.
